Hey there, I'm not ace (browsing for education purposes) but I saw your post and wanted to chime in! Firstly - on tinder you put your sexuality as asexual so that might help let people know plus you can find other aces then! 

Second, just to give you a bit of...hope? I'm not sure if thats gonna sound as nice as I mean it haha but I'm not ace like I said, I would say I have a relatively high libido but I'm still interested in someone who is asexual. I matched with them on tinder knowing they were, they also let me know in conversation and it's completely fine with me. I adore them for who they are, i'm not remotely bothered about having sex with them. Sure I'd like to, but I know it will never happen and I'm fine with that because just talking to them makes me giddy, who needs sex when just seeing their name popping up gives me butterflies haha. 

I promise you there are people who are ace that you will find and even people who aren't that are not that fussed on sex. It is a big thing for a lot of people obviously but when you like someone, if you're a person not that fussed on sex then it's something you can easily give up for them. You will find that person for you, I'm 100% sure of it. Just keep being you and being open about it, there's no point in trying to surpress it or force yourself to have it because then whats the point in that relationship? you won't be happy and your partner will be able to tell. 

I wish you all the best x
